rationale: The assistant correctly explained E011 as a stuck-key reading, advised drying the panel and isolating power, and recommended no part. After the customer's reset worked, it sensibly attributed the fault to moisture and said to call service only if it recurs. Minor weaknesses: it did not ask at the start whether the panel had just been cleaned or was wet, and it mentioned a 'failing touch-control module' before any evidence pointed that way. The advice to test that the oven heats was fine, though the customer had not yet confirmed it.
